'''Shran Etison''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tuttin IV]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took over the planet, [[Tendis Ancum]] and his wife, [[Jioie Ancum|Jioie]], left their son [[Ryley Ancum|Ryley]] in the care of Shran while they left for [[Beltrix III]].<ref name="GC6" />
